# Cully v0.6.1

This patch release fixes live Codex advisor signals when Codex runs hooks through a persistent app server. `cully codex` now binds the Codex session to its pane at SessionStart and accepts tool counters only from that session. The local binding stores an opaque session hash; prompts and tool output are not saved.

The Cully skill now explains the distinct Claude, Codex and Cursor advisor surfaces, how to verify real signal delivery, and when to use live checks instead of memory history. The project skill and its `AGENTS.md` pointer are included in this repository.

Installation and deployment docs now show the remote memory option: users install the CLI, advisor and agent integration locally with `--mcp-url`, while operators can run Cully MCP, the data API, Mem0 and databases on separate hosts.

Release automation publishes binaries and service images. Personal deployment remains a separate manual workflow.
